text.p: Venezuelan telephone company CANTV said it approved a 13.24 bolivar per share dividend, but it did not give a date for when the payment would be made.
The decision was taken by the executive board after Monday's annual general meeting.
"In the afternoon, the executive board decided on a 13.24 bolivar per share dividend whose payment date will be fixed shortly," said company president Gustavo Roosen in a press release.
Venezuela sold 34.8 percent of the company in a global share offering in November last year, raising $1.1 billion in one of the Latin America's largest public placements in recent years.
Roosen confirmed that, in 1996, net profits rose to 208 billion bolivars from 32 billion the year before.

"We invested more than $348 million during that time (1996) and for 1997 we expect to invest again around $591 million," he said. "This is evidence of our promise to continue expanding telecommunications infrastructure in the country."
